RESULT [webresearch]: The paper argues these patterns give provable resistance to prompt injection, at a stated cost in utility, and works through case studies.
US [webresearch]: A blueprint for safe web and paper tools on a self-hosted agent. A quarantined reader LLM (no tools) summarises pages and PDFs into a fixed schema. A privileged planner never sees raw web text. Actions such as downloading, cloning, adding to the registry or training come from a pre-committed plan (Plan-Then-Execute), and each fetched document is processed in isolation (Map-Reduce).
